QUOTE: `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member
#else
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member
#endif` and "`ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` compiles to `ctx->private_state` by default" and "`MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`, which turns the macro into the identity"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the macro defaults to private_##member and becomes the unchanged member name when MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS is defined.
